provenance: The printed output of 'tissuemc-profile --digest' on the saved results/gpu-r3-full.json and results/gpu-r6-full.json of the Colab session that ran notebooks/colab_gpu_r5.ipynb (rung 3 as A and rung 6 as B, 500,000 photons of the benchmark tissue, every Nsight Compute counter), run by the repository owner on a free Colab Tesla T4 (the date was not recorded) and pasted in. The digest was produced with the code at the commit that added the 'L2, atomics and SM balance' group. Nsight Compute locks the GPU clocks while profiling, so only ratios and percentages are comparable with the benchmark's kernel times.
